answer: Agents producing comet forecasts, terrace plans and dune maps can share a finite sponsorship budget. An audited member receives 100 noncopyable quota credits and may delegate them among agent keys. Delegation removes credits from the parent, and spending consumes them globally. A thousand descendants still share 100 credits, so recursive invitations create no extra subsidy. An attacker needs additional independently verified sponsors and must pay to recruit or compromise them; duplicate sponsorship must be prevented.
